content: Industry consensus: risk management (position sizing, drawdown limits, exposure caps, kill switches) must be a primary, independent architectural layer, not an afterthought bolted onto the strategy/signal layer. Kill switches are the last line of defense against software bugs, broker outages, or anomalies and must be testable, immediately effective, and have clear authority/restart procedures (per BoE PRA SS5/18 guidance for institutional algo trading).
